name: packing-slip
title: Packing slip
for_each: select id, number as name from orders where status in ('open','picked')

sections.title: Deliver to
sections.sql: select o.number, o.recipient_name, o.address, o.postcode, o.country, o.required_by from orders o where o.id = $1

sections.title: Items
sections.sql: select p.sku, p.name as product, l.quantity, case when p.dangerous_goods then 'Dangerous goods' else '' end as handling from order_lines l join products p on p.id = l.product_id where l.order_id = $1 order by p.sku

sections.title: Charges by billing run
sections.note: A charge statement prepared for review. Your accounts system issues the tax invoice.
sections.sql: select r.name, r.period_from, r.period_to, r.status, l.currency, l.kind, l.units, l.rate_cents, l.amount_cents from charge_lines l join charge_runs r on r.id = l.run_id where l.client_id = $1 order by r.period_to desc, l.kind

sections.title: Despatch against agreed days, last 28 days
sections.sql: select despatched_28d, on_time_28d, late_28d, on_time_pct, late_now from sla_view where client_id = $1

sections.title: Stock on hand
sections.sql: select sku, product, on_hand, allocated, available, reorder_point from product_stock_view where client_id = $1 and active order by sku

sections.title: Inbound deliveries
sections.sql: select name, expected_on, received_on, note from asns where client_id = $1 order by expected_on

name: returns-note
title: Returns note
for_each: select r.id, r.name from returns r

sections.title: Return
sections.sql: select r.name, o.number as order_number, p.sku, p.name as product, r.quantity, r.reason, r.received_on, r.outcome, r.processed_on from returns r join orders o on o.id = r.order_id join products p on p.id = r.product_id where r.id = $1
